assessment: This important study examines how the method used to prepare Mycobacterium tuberculosis bacilli for use in experimental infection models affects outcomes. The authors provide compelling evidence indicating that the method of preparation affects the bacterial cell wall and substantially influences both host responses and infection outcomes in models of TB infection. The data will be useful for interpreting published TB literature and for future studies probing M. tuberculosis virulence. The work will be of interest to tuberculosis researchers and microbiologists in general.
